privacyPage.seoDescription: How Wedevs handles the data you send through the contact form and the analytics data collected on this site, and how to ask for its removal.
privacyPage.support: What data this site collects, why, and how to ask us to delete it.

sections.title: What do we collect through the contact form?
sections.body: When you send the contact form we receive your name, email, project type, budget range and message. The form is processed by Netlify Forms, our hosting provider. We use this data only to reply to your request.

sections.title: Do we sell or share your data?
sections.body: No. We do not sell your data or share it with third parties, other than the providers that host this site and process the form.

sections.title: How long do we keep it?
sections.body: We keep contact requests while a conversation or project is active, and delete them on request.

sections.title: How can you ask for deletion?
sections.body: Write to us by email and we will delete your data within 30 days.

analytics.title: Do we use analytics?
analytics.body: Yes. We use Google Analytics 4 to measure visits in aggregate (pages viewed, country, device). Google Analytics sets cookies for this. We do not use the data to identify you.
